name: Stair Generator VR
summary: Using the app is simple: just measure the width and height of the opening where you want to place the staircase, and enter those dimensions into the application. Then specify other parameters—such as step width, tread depth, and staircase type (the default is a standard straight angled flight, but two additional styles are available)—along with other fine‑tuning options in the dedicated settings panel.
